lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Okay, important question. What's your boba order?

reply.speaker: jessica
reply.text: Okay, taste. Mine's taro with lychee jelly. Don't forget it.

reply.speaker: jessica
reply.text: Boring. It's taro with lychee jelly for me, by the way.

reply.speaker: jessica
reply.text: Trời ơi. Taro with lychee jelly. Educate yourself.
reply.translation: Oh my god. Taro with lychee jelly. Educate yourself.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: You hear that bass? That's my Civic. Lowered, white, perfect.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Bass and dubstep, windows down. That's the only way to drive.

reply.speaker: jessica
reply.text: See, you get it. Lowered white Civic gang.

choices.text: Isn't that bad for your ears?

reply.speaker: jessica
reply.text: Probably. Still not turning it down.

reply.speaker: jessica
reply.text: Get out of my car. Respectfully.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: You know who taught me Tiến Lên?

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: My cô and chú. Every Tết, lì xì money on the table, everybody yelling.
lines.translation: My aunt and uncle. Every Lunar New Year, red-envelope money on the table, everybody yelling.

choices.text: So that's why you play so aggressive.

reply.speaker: jessica
reply.text: Exactly. At Tết, you play it safe, you go broke.
reply.translation: Exactly. At Lunar New Year, you play it safe, you go broke.

reply.speaker: jessica
reply.text: So loud. Best nights of the year.

choices.text: I learned from a YouTube video.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Look. Look at him. This is Bơ.
lines.translation: Look. Look at him. This is Bơ ("Avocado").

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Pomeranian. Ten pounds of attitude. Like his mom.

choices.text: Bơ is perfect. I'd die for him.

reply.speaker: jessica
reply.text: Correct answer. He'd let you, too.

choices.text: I'm more of a cat person.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Long day. Twelve clients.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Every set I do is a little more saved for my own studio.

choices.text: Your own lash studio? You'd crush that.

reply.speaker: jessica
reply.text: Right? Somewhere cute. My name on the door.

choices.text: Do you like working for someone else?

reply.speaker: jessica
reply.text: It's fine. It's temporary. Opening my own lash studio is the dream.

reply.speaker: jessica
reply.text: Just eyelashes? Watch me open a whole lash studio on 'just eyelashes.'

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Don't talk to me before my cà phê sữa đá. Every morning. Non-negotiable.
lines.translation: Don't talk to me before my Vietnamese iced coffee. Every morning. Non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: I'm 24, by the way. Don't act like you didn't wonder.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: My birthday's March 14. Pisces. Explains a lot, honestly.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: I'm 5'3". Five-seven in platforms. Festival height.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Days off? I'm at an EDM festival. Every time. Sleep is for Mondays.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: You know what I can't stand? People who show up late. Like, just say you're not coming.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Everything I own is black. Favorite color. Not a phase.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Tết is the best holiday. Food, lì xì, cards all night. Not even close.
lines.translation: Lunar New Year is the best holiday. Food, red envelopes, cards all night. Not even close.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Nine's my lucky number. Nine always hits.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Ideal date? Late-night food crawl at the night market. Just saying.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Once I actually like you, I'll call you anh. Don't get your hopes up.
lines.translation: Once I actually like you, I'll call you anh ("you", for a guy she's close to). Don't get your hopes up.
